hero.title: Credit Transfer Policy
hero.subtitle: Transferring earned credits into BAUST programs

overview.heading: Policy Overview
overview.text: BAUST allows eligible students to transfer academic credits earned at recognised institutions, subject to evaluation against its own curriculum. The complete rules, eligibility and evaluation criteria are set out in the official policy document.
